import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv')

# Plot the distribution of transaction amounts
sns.histplot(data['amount'], kde=True, bins=50)
plt.title('Distribution of Transaction Amounts')
plt.xlabel('Amount ($)')
plt.ylabel('Frequency')
plt.savefig('output_amount.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Plot the distribution of hour of day for fraudulent and non-fraudulent transactions
sns.countplot(x='hour_of_day', hue='is_fraud', data=data)
plt.title('Hour of Day Distribution for Fraudulent vs. Non-Fraudulent Transactions')
plt.xlabel('Hour of Day')
plt.ylabel('Frequency')
plt.legend(title='Transaction Type')
plt.savefig('output_hour.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Plot the distribution of transaction types
sns.countplot(x='transaction_type', data=data)
plt.title('Distribution of Transaction Types')
plt.xlabel('Transaction Type')
plt.ylabel('Frequency')
plt.savefig('output_type.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

# Plot the box plot for amount of fraudulent and non-fraudulent transactions
sns.boxplot(x='is_fraud', y='amount', data=data)
plt.title('Box Plot of Amount for Fraudulent vs. Non-Fraudulent Transactions')
plt.xlabel('Transaction Type')
plt.ylabel('Amount ($)')
plt.legend(title='Transaction Type')
plt.savefig('output_box.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
